def main():
    s = input().strip()
    
    res = 0
    if s is not None and len(s) > 1:
        i = 0
        while i < len(s):
            current = s[i]
            count = 1
            while i + count < len(s) and s[i + count] == current:
                count += 1
            if count % 2 == 0:
                res += 1
            i += count
    
    print(res)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
